import unittest

from inventory.models import Item
from inventory.pricing import summarize


class BoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_threshold_quantity(self):
        totals = summarize([Item(100, 10)])
        self.assertEqual(totals["total_cents"], 900)
        self.assertEqual(totals["discount_cents"], 100)

    def test_exact_top_threshold_quantity(self):
        totals = summarize([Item(100, 50)])
        self.assertEqual(totals["total_cents"], 4000)
        self.assertEqual(totals["discount_cents"], 1000)

    def test_line_totals_round_half_up(self):
        totals = summarize([Item(1005, 11)])
        self.assertEqual(totals["subtotal_cents"], 11055)
        self.assertEqual(totals["total_cents"], 9950)

    def test_tiers_apply_per_line(self):
        totals = summarize([Item(100, 50), Item(100, 9)])
        self.assertEqual(totals["subtotal_cents"], 5900)
        self.assertEqual(totals["discount_cents"], 1000)
        self.assertEqual(totals["total_cents"], 4900)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
